messages:
Arianna: Hey team — launching 'Serving Wins' webinar next Thurs. Need a small deliverable set: 1) hero image (800x420) + social crop, static + GIF; 2) 1-page benchmark one-pager (single-slide PDF) with latency vs cost highlights; 3) simplified inbound routing diagram (SVG) for handoff to SDRs. Brand compliance required. Deadline: Wed EOD. Figma: https://figma.com/file/xxxxxx (invite open).
Mateo: Got it. Quick Qs — do we have canonical benchmark numbers to show? and is the GIF just an animated sparkline or do you want micro-anim of product UI?
Arianna: Priorities: (1) hero (2) one-pager (3) routing diagram. Use the safety numbers from last benchmark: median p50 latency 42ms, cost/token $0.0009, 2.8x throughput uplift on batching. GIF = animated sparkline + subtle token count morph, 3s loop.
Mateo: Perfect. I'll mock two hero comps tonight — one typographic-first, one diagram-forward. Will include accessible alt text and a version with high-contrast palette.
Priya: Brand note — avoid the teal gradient we used in the April exec slides (fails contrast at small sizes). Use Primary Blue + Off-Black text. Make sure CTA buttons follow our rounded corner spec and 4.5:1 contrast. I can run QA before final.
Sam: Legal — don't include any customer names or exact SLA promises. If we reference throughput uplift, add "based on internal benchmark" in small footnote. Also confirm no regulated-product imagery.
Lina: Copy options for hero headline: 1) "Serve intelligent features at predictable cost" 2) "Make inference inexpensive and reliable" 3) "Ship LLM features with production-grade economics" (my vote: 3). Microcopy for CTA: "Register — seats limited" or "Join the webinar".
Tess: File delivery preferences: Figma master + exported PNG/JIF/SVG. Please include a PDF one-pager sized 8.5x11 and an A4 variant for partners. File naming: serving-wins_hero_v1.png, serving-wins_onepager_v1.pdf, serving-wins_routing_v1.svg. Tag assets in the figma page with #webinar.
Omar: For the GIF: 3s loop, 24fps max, keep filesize under 1.2MB for social. I can hand off an MP4 for web if needed. Should motion be subtle (sparkline) or more pronounced (bars morph)?
Mateo: Subtle sparkline + token counter morph will be safest for clarity and filesize. I'll export a MP4 + optimized GIF.
Arianna: Great. Priya/Priya QA and Sam legal check required before Wed EOD. Lina please lock headline by Tue noon. @design-bot remind-team in 24h if first comps not posted. :thumbsup:
design-bot: Reminder scheduled — Mateo asked to upload first comps within 24 hours.
Mateo: Uploaded first comps to Figma: frames "Hero_A" and "Hero_B". Ping me for feedback.
Priya: Reviewing now. Quick accessibility note: add focus ring states on CTA and ensure text scales correctly at 320px width.
Lina: Locking headline: "Ship LLM features with production-grade economics". Small tweak for one-pager subhead: "Latency, cost, and reliability you can measure."
Sam: Legal sign-off pending the tiny footnote language. Suggest: "Results based on internal tests; actual results may vary."
Tess: Noted — I'll create the export checklist and update the design ops board with the deliverables and stakeholders.
Arianna: Thanks all — hold for final QA signoff. If anything slips, we push only the hero and landing today and queue docs for later.
Mateo: Will update Figma and post final exports by Wed 3pm PT.
Priya: QA done on Hero_A. Minor color tweak made and noted in comments.
Sam: Legal approved the footnote copy.
Arianna: Closing loop — thank you. :rocket:
